title: Internal interface slope-correction mechanism review
question: Can the mixed C4L behavior be explained and improved by the parameter-free central finite-volume interface slope implied by the existing B9 terminal and bulk one-sided linear reconstructions, without changing qH or adding state?

cases.reference: immutable A2 Reference used by B8/B9/C4H/C4L

baseline.endpoint_interface_K: K_i from the B9 terminal storage reconstruction

central_candidate.name: CENTRAL_PIECEWISE_LINEAR_INTERFACE_GRADIENT
central_candidate.derivation: Use the already reconstructed B9 terminal slope a_t over thickness d and bulk slope b_bulk over thickness B. The secant slope between the two reconstructed control-volume centers is s_central=(d*a_t+B*b_bulk)/(B+d).
central_candidate.endpoint_qi: K_i*(1-s_central), using the unchanged B9 terminal-interface K_i

reference_slope_diagnostic.K_ref_bar: trapezoidal endpoint mean constitutive K evaluated at Reference projected interface theta
reference_slope_diagnostic.note: s_ref is an interval-effective diagnostic, not asserted to equal a pointwise Richards derivative.

cubic_comparator.role: mechanism comparator only; no new cubic execution authority
cubic_comparator.comparison: Compare correction relative to baseline a_t: delta_cubic=s_cubic-a_t versus delta_ref=s_ref-a_t.

outputs: baseline, central and cubic interval-effective slope errors relative to s_ref: bias, MAE, RMS, max_abs
delta_ref, delta_central and delta_cubic signed distributions
fraction intervals where central correction has same sign as delta_ref
fraction intervals where cubic correction has same sign as delta_ref
fraction intervals where central slope is closer to s_ref than baseline and cubic
baseline, central and cubic qi bias, MAE, RMS, max_abs and sign mismatches
qH identity residual for central candidate

case_support.moving: For WT_RISE and WT_FALL, CENTRAL qi must have strictly lower RMS and MAE than B9 baseline and no greater sign-mismatch count.
case_support.hold: For WT_HOLD, CENTRAL qi RMS and MAE must be no greater than B9 baseline within 1e-12 and sign-mismatch count no greater.
case_support.mechanism_consistency: Report, but do not gate support on, whether central slope MAE/RMS is also lower than baseline and cubic. A flux improvement can differ from slope improvement because K is nonlinear.

decisions.CENTRAL_INTERFACE_GRADIENT_STATIC_CANDID: All hard gates pass; central qi supports both widths in RISE and FALL and is noninferior in HOLD for both widths.
decisions.CENTRAL_INTERFACE_GRADIENT_MOVING_ONLY: All hard gates pass; all four moving cases support, but at least one HOLD case fails noninferiority.
decisions.CENTRAL_INTERFACE_GRADIENT_MIXED: All hard gates pass but moving support is not uniform across width/direction.
decisions.C4M_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any hard authority or numerical gate fails.

interpretation_boundary: C4M is a static Reference-state mechanism review.
Positive central support does not authorize propagated dynamics.
Cubic is a comparator only and cannot be rescued by post-hoc direction selection.
No blending factor, fitted weight, Hdot term, memory state or direction switch is allowed.

pre_execution_operationalisation.primary_interval_slope: For Reference, TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR, CENTRAL and cubic, compute the primary interval-effective slope as s=1-q_interval/Kbar, with q_interval the trapezoidal mean of endpoint fluxes and Kbar the arithmetic mean of that representation's endpoint interface K. This makes q=Kbar*(1-s) an exact identity for every representation.
pre_execution_operationalisation.correction_definitions: delta_ref=s_ref-s_base; delta_central=s_central-s_base; delta_cubic=s_cubic-s_base use the primary interval-effective slopes above.
pre_execution_operationalisation.endpoint_slopes: Arithmetic means of endpoint a_t, b_bulk, central endpoint slope and cubic endpoint slope are secondary diagnostics only and never replace the primary interval-effective slope in adjudication.
pre_execution_operationalisation.zero_floor_role: Pure numerical guard for sign fractions and cosine calculations; not a hydrological tolerance.
pre_execution_operationalisation.c4l_reproduction: Recomputed cubic qi summary metrics must reproduce the persisted authoritative C4L case RMS and MAE within 1e-10 cm/day before cubic mechanism comparisons are interpreted.
